rows.grounds: compound kāma-ākarṣaṇa-kāriṇī; feminine nominative plural ending -yaḥ sandhis to -yo before vighnaṃ
accusative singular neuter object of vighnantu
third-person plural imperative active of root vighn, governing vighnaṃ
indeclinable numeral modifying the implied sixteen deities

items.question: Which sixteen desire-attracting deities are invoked to destroy obstacles?
premises: obstacle removal is sought before practice
items.inference: the verse invokes sixteen kāmākarṣaṇa deities to remove obstacles
uncertainties: exact identity of the sixteen deities is not specified in this verse
items.plain_english: May the sixteen desire-attracting ones destroy obstacles.
